name: A Loop Apart
source:
You were just a normal art student with dreams of making it in the city. How is it that you're in a concert one night and back to a week ago in a flash? Could the mysterious disappearances and power surges have something to do with this? You obviously have to find a way to stop this. Hopefully, one of these five people you've been seeing all week can help you figure it out before you find yourself lost in time forever. 

Falling in love with them wasn't part of the plan though.

[From [url=https://insertnameheregames.itch.io/a-loop-apart]itch.io[/url]]
